bio: Enjoy an Afternoon Tea at 20 Stories Rooftop Restaurant in the heart of Manchester and experience the panoramic views of the city.  Afternoon Tea is served in the main restaurant, a captivating dining area with huge windows allowing you to enjoy the breathtaking, unparalleled 360-degree view of the Manchester skyline right from your table.  Their menu features a range of locally sourced sandwiches and canapés and a selection of teas and coffees. 20 Stories Manchester invites you to indulge in their homemade scones and delicious tarts, and offers Nyetimber and miniature cocktail pairing Afternoon Tea.  20 Stories Manchester is located in Spinningfields Manchester, just a short walk from Manchester Opera House and Deansgate train station.
